assessment.price_case: This is a main 0.5 line at -185, which needs about -185 to break even. The model's fair price is around -226, while the market sits close to the quote. Any adverse move in the line removes the case.

qualitative_review.countercase: The model and the market broadly agree that the under is the likelier outcome. If Wolf starts and limits San Jose's scoring, the under could still be reasonable. Even so, the price leaves almost no cushion for model error.
